# Lead Hub Repository Map
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)
Lead Hub launched on 2026-09-15 and was conditionally closed on 2026-09-21; follow-on operations controls remain active.

This file is the repository guide, not the source of truth for detailed project status. The map below was checked against tracked repository paths on 2026-09-24.

## Current Project Position

- The LeadLab Director accepted the launched application. Project closure is conditional while residual operations work continues.
- Gate 1 environment and ownership evidence is still open. Other follow-on controls and their owners remain recorded in PM Control.
- The latest project reconciliation is in `pm-control/project-control.md`; the current closure and handoff record is `pm-control/artifacts/lead-hub-closure-report.md`.
- Use `pm-control/registers/` for the current state of individual actions, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and changes. Do not infer that operational controls are complete from the launch or closure.

## Task Routing

| Need | Start here |
|---|---|
| Understand repository rules or vocabulary | `AGENTS.md` or `CONCEPTS.md` |
| Get repository map and top-level routing | `CONTEXT.md` |
| Check project position or active controls | `pm-control/project-control.md`, then the relevant file in `pm-control/registers/` |
| Review project closure and operations handoff | `pm-control/artifacts/lead-hub-closure-report.md` |
| Confirm scope, backlog, delivery plan, or platform decision | The matching file in `artifacts/` |
| Change or test the application | `workspace/CONTEXT.md`, `application/CONTEXT.md`, and `application/source/` |
| Read end-user or architecture documentation | `docs/README.md` |
| Run or resume the standard delivery pipeline | `workspace/stages/` through `workspace/CONTEXT.md` |
| Process a GitHub issue labeled `matic` | `workspace/matic-workflow/CONTEXT.md` |
| Review a past application delivery | `application/runs/<dated-run>/` |
| Review a past PM process | `pm-control/runs/<control-run>/` |
| Review prior status reconciliations | `project-statrep/<dated-run>/` |
| Verify historic SharePoint-era facts | `Old artifacts/`; treat them as history, not current application guidance |
| Review or maintain agent skills | `.agents/skills/` |

## Source and Maintenance Rules

- `application/source/` is the canonical application implementation.
- `pm-control/registers/` holds current item-level project-control states. This map does not replace those records.
- Approved project scope and delivery direction are recorded in `artifacts/`; the technical delivery contracts are in `workspace/`.
- Dated folders under `application/runs/`, `pm-control/runs/`, and `project-statrep/` are summarized by pattern here so new runs do not make this map stale.
- Refresh this file when a top-level area, major source subtree, or project phase changes. Verify the tree against tracked paths before updating the verified date.
